spans.s:
शौल्क mfn. (-ल्कः-ल्की-ल्कं) Relating to customs or duties, levied as a tax,
&c.
 m. (-ल्कः) A superintendent of tolls or customs, a custom-
house officer.
 E. शुल्क a toll or tax, aff. अण् ।

शौल्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a tax, a toll, &c.
 m. (-कः)
Superintendent of tolls or customs.
 E. शुल्क a toll, and ठक् aff.

शौल्विक m. (-कः) A copper-smith.
 E. शुल्व copper, ठक् aff.
सौल्विक m. (-कः) A copper-smith; more usually शौल्विक ।
